🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 27, 2026

Moon, at home in Cancer, holds a trine to Mercury, in Scorpio. The same water temperament, twice over: the worth of a thing and the account of it briefly coincide.

Easier — Reviewing, sorting, naming what a thing is worth to you.
Harder — Mistaking an easy day for a free one.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Virgo. From Cancer, Moon cuts across you: the sum arrives before the appetite. Cardinal fire meets a bill. Mars has been out of Leo for four weeks now.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you from Libra, a sign it owns outright. From Scorpio, Mercury quotes your worth back at you. Fixed earth pays to hold on. Four weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you and passes through Scorpio as a guest. From Libra, Venus agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Air bends, and bending costs nothing here. The square of a week ago is off it now.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, has the run of Cancer and sets its own terms. Mercury in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Cardinal water opens the account without argument. Sun let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, crosses Sagittarius untitled. From Scorpio, Mercury cuts across the appetite. Fire keeps its grip past the point it is worth. Since Sun crossed out of Scorpio, the question has changed.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon in Cancer opens a gap you have to step into. Mutable earth: two answers, and both are affordable. Mercury went direct two weeks ago; the re-reading is over.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. From Cancer, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Cardinal air: the beginning has a price on it. What pressed four weeks ago has cleared.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you, untitled in Virgo. From Cancer, Moon concedes the point early. Water keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. The hold Mercury had four weeks ago is not there any more.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Sun is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Mutable fire: the two accounts collapse into one. After four weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. From Cancer, Moon returns your estimate with corrections. Earth opens the file, and the file has a price. The conjunction to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Sun sextiles you from Sagittarius: help that waits to be asked for. Air keeps what it has, cheaply. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon trines you from Cancer, meeting no resistance. Water adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. A week ago Jupiter was still held by Sun; that is finished.
